title: Push Band Set Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pushband:set
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(exercise_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Push Band set events land each day and how many distinct exercise values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Push Band set records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct exercise values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It scans how much Push Band set activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
